summary: Onity Group Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing the closing of a sale of reverse mortgage assets to Finance of America Reverse LLC on June 30, 2026. The sold assets include servicing rights on ~20,000 Ginnie Mae HECM loans ($5.2B UPB) and the reverse origination pipeline; Onity ceases reverse originations. Net proceeds are $70–$80M, to be used for growth and debt reduction. A three-year subservicing agreement was entered. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The transaction is closed, so the risk-arb angle is moot; focus shifts to Onity’s forward mortgage and buyout securitization strategy.
